messages:
alex: FYI LuminaHealth is seeing higher tail latency on Dedicated pool after last kernel update. Asked for higher token budget + queue cap. See perf traces below.

maria: Can you paste the traces? which model + quant? :eyes:

alex: model: gpt-small-v2-int8, dedicated-gpu-pool "ded1-eu". Post-update kernel selector picked matmul_v3 on 2x sequence paths. KV cache miss rate jumped. attaching flame snippet:
```
flame: cpu  ...
kernel_select->matmul_v3 42%
kv_cache_lookup 18% (eviction spikes)
batch_form 12% (queue wait ↑)
```

jin: hmm kv eviction spikes => smaller effective batch sizes. What are current token_budget / queue_limit?

alex: current token_budget: "800", queue_limit: "512", max_batch_time_ms: "20"

maria: I'd try token_budget=1200, queue_limit=1024 for canary. Also set prefer_kernel_override to matmul_v2 for that pool until we validate.

jin: agree. Also enable per-request kv_prefetch to reduce cold misses in tail (set kv_prefetch=true for luminahealth routes)

alex: new config i propose:
```
{
  "token_budget": 1200,
  "queue_limit": 1024,
  "max_batch_time_ms": 18,
  "prefer_kernel": "matmul_v2",
  "kv_prefetch": true
}
```

ops-bot: deploy request queued by alex for pool ded1-eu. ETA: 15m

maria: run perf job 'dedicated-batch-sim' with 95th/99th token latency checks and KV hit histogram. If 99th drops by >20% then rollout.

jin: I'll run canary 1/5 capacity tonight and attach profiler. Expecting minor throughput hit but big tail improvement.

alex: noted. I'll notify LuminaHealth CS and set up a short maintenance window. :thumbsup:

maria: if regressions show up, fallback plan: immediate kernel revert + reduce token_budget to 700 and enable fallback model fp16-compat.

jin: added test IDs: perf-1790456789-A, profile-1790456789-B. Will post results here.

alex: thanks — also adding alert for token_budget_saturation to SRE pager if >90% for >5m.

ops-bot: canary deploy started. link: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/1790456789

jin: first profiler snapshot: KV miss tail still high but decreased. 99th token latency down 27%. uploading logs.

alex: awesome. LuminaHealth CS responded :heart: — they saw no user-facing errors.

maria: cool. schedule gradual rollout over 2 hours, monitor errors and cost bump. :calendar:

alex: closing loop once rollout finished. thanks team.
